change: Boss Rush phone and PC editions added as related links under FINAL BOSS; style header declared for the existing look.
person_made_it: Yes: every entry is a site Gordon made with Darby for real people, and the new links go to the game his own dodgeball team plays.
emcee_who_is_speaking: A quiet curator's voice, short labels that say what each thing is and what you can do there.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Late morning in a gallery: warm paper, good light, nothing shouting.
did_the_click_pay_me: Yes for the new links: one tap from FINAL BOSS lands on a playable game instead of a team page you have to scroll through.
works_for_the_recipient: A visitor can pick phone or PC right from the cabinet, and the page still works with JS off.
taught_me_something: A little: the Boss Rush line names Sin City rules (8 on 8, five balls, a 15-second ball-control clock).
told_me_the_truth: Yes: rules wording comes from the live play page, and the unlisted family and friends sites were left out on purpose.
weakest: The related links are text only with no thumbnail, so Boss Rush is easy to miss inside the FINAL BOSS card; a small game still would help.
